title: Fire Magic — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Fire Magic.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Crafted with Fire." Premium tier. Fire Magic has been making premium outdoor cooking equipment in the City of Industry, California since 1937. Their Echelon Diamond series features the Magic View window for lid-down cooking visibility and hot surface ignition that lights reliably every time. One of the oldest outdoor cooking brands in America.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Serious outdoor kitchen builds. Customers who want American-made premium grills with decades of heritage.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Fire Magic:

• Made in California since 1937 — one of the oldest outdoor brands

• Magic View window lets you monitor cooking without opening the lid

• Hot surface ignition — no batteries, no piezo, lights every time

• Echelon Diamond series rivals Lynx and Hestan at slightly lower pricing

• Heavy 304 stainless construction built for coastal environments
